import csv,hashlib,json,os,re
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")==""
start=datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
root=Path("test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933").resolve()
group=root/"models/Qwen3-14B/calibration/real/repeat-1"
hashes={}
def read(path):
    digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); hashes[str(path)]=digest; return path.read_text()
assert read(group/"BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE").strip()=="complete"
cases={"latency_256x128_r1":32,"service_1024x256_r4":64,"saturation_1024x256_inf":64}
timestamp=re.compile(r"^\[(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d)\]")
result=[]
for case,n in cases.items():
    path=group/"cases"/case
    assert read(path/"status.txt").strip()=="ok"
    manifest=json.loads(read(path/"autobench_trace.manifest.json"))
    native=[json.loads(line) for line in read(path/"benchmark.jsonl").splitlines() if line.strip()][-1]
    assert manifest["request_count"]==native["completed"]==n
    assert native["server_info"]["device"]=="cuda" and native["server_info"]["attention_backend"]=="triton"
    assert native["server_info"]["context_length"]==2048
    assert native["server_info"]["disable_cuda_graph"] and native["server_info"]["disable_overlap_schedule"]
    log=read(group/"cases"/f"{case}.server.log").splitlines()
    begins=[]; ends=[]; warnings=[]
    for line in log:
        match=timestamp.match(line)
        if not match: continue
        at=datetime.strptime(match.group(1),"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        if "POST /start_profile HTTP/1.1" in line: begins.append(at)
        if "POST /stop_profile HTTP/1.1" in line: ends.append(at)
        if "compile after serving started" in line: warnings.append((at,line))
    assert len(begins)==len(ends)==1 and begins[0]<ends[0]
    before=[line for at,line in warnings if at<begins[0]]
    within=[line for at,line in warnings if begins[0]<=at<=ends[0]]
    after=[line for at,line in warnings if at>ends[0]]
    schedules=[json.loads(line) for line in read(path/"TP0.schedule_batch.jsonl").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    selected=[row for row in schedules if row.get("forward_mode") in (1,2) and row.get("request_infos") and float(row["iter_latency"])>0]
    assert selected
    result.append({"case":case,"requests":n,"timing_rows":len(selected),"prefill_rows":sum(row["forward_mode"]==1 for row in selected),"decode_rows":sum(row["forward_mode"]==2 for row in selected),"start_profile_local":begins[0].isoformat(),"stop_profile_local":ends[0].isoformat(),"logged_compile_warnings_before_window":len(before),"logged_compile_warnings_inside_window":len(within),"logged_compile_warnings_after_window":len(after),"compile_warning_lines":before+within+after})
for path,digest in hashes.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
